seo.title: Community Roadmap | openIndu
seo.description: Explore the openIndu community roadmap, from shared knowledge and reusable engineering assets to tool collaboration and scenario validation, followed by our five project directions.

hero.title: openIndu Community Roadmap
hero.subtitle: Build together: share field knowledge, create reusable engineering assets, and connect tools through verifiable practice
hero.formula: Forum + openIndu-vision + openIndu-studio + openIndu-cim & openIndu-platform + PLC Experiment

roadmap.heading: From Shared Knowledge to Validated Practice
roadmap.note: These stages describe our community's development direction, not release dates or completed milestones. Repository releases, tests, and validation records show actual progress.

knowledge.title: Share Field Knowledge
knowledge.description: Bring practical problems into the forum. Record context, constraints, process knowledge, and validation methods so others can contribute and review.

assets.title: Build Reusable Assets
assets.description: Turn reviewed experience into guides, templates, mappings, and engineering workflow artifacts that can be reused and checked.

collaboration.title: Connect Project Tools
collaboration.description: Develop collaboration across vision, engineering workflows, connectivity, and industrial data, with explicit interfaces and capability boundaries.

validation.title: Validate Real Scenarios
validation.description: Use reproducible cases to check tool collaboration. Share supported versions, results, and limitations before extending a capability claim.

forum.title: Forum
forum.description: Community knowledge across industrial control, automation, manufacturing processes, and industry observations. Topics can remain open as evidence evolves.

vision.title: Industrial Vision
vision.description: Exploration of cross-camera, cross-algorithm inspection and workflow orchestration. Support depends on repositories, versions, and validation records.

studio.title: Engineering Assets
studio.description: Engineering workflows around electrical modules, diagrams, BOM, I/O planning, and PLC/HMI intermediate artifacts.

data.title: Connectivity and Data
data.description: Connect equipment, manufacturing systems, and industrial data for collection, traceability, and analysis. Protocols are validated per driver, version, and environment.

plc.title: Open Control Experiment
plc.description: RK3588 + openEuler + RTOS/real-time Linux + EtherCAT exploration. Real-time, HIL, endurance, and fault-recovery evidence is not complete.

interaction.heading: How the Directions Work Together
interaction.flowStep1: The forum preserves field context, constraints, validation steps, and known boundaries
interaction.flowStep2: Reviewed experience can become guides, templates, mappings, or experimental cases
interaction.flowStep3: Tools reuse those assets only within explicit status and evidence boundaries
interaction.appsCore: Organises engineering assets and generation workflows
interaction.appsRight: Connects equipment, manufacturing systems, and industrial data
interaction.loop: PLC Experiment remains Experiment / E0. It is not production-ready without real-time, HIL, endurance, and fault-recovery evidence.

rows.traditional: A direction means a finished product
rows.openindu: Direction, status, and evidence are shown separately
Content is labelled as Content, without delivery claims
README, releases, tests, and limitations define status

rows.traditional: One license describes the whole ecosystem
rows.openindu: Each repository LICENSE and dependency obligation is authoritative

rows.traditional: An experiment can replace a hardware PLC
rows.openindu: Experiment / E0 and the next evidence gates are explicit
